Senior Go Developer, Razorpay
Dec 2024 - Present
Led development of a payment orchestration microservice in Go handling routing and retries for card/netbanking flows. Implemented gRPC interfaces for internal service-to-service calls and migrated critical components to Kubernetes, reducing pod restart incidents by 30%. Introduced structured logging and Linux-based health probes to shorten MTTR on production incidents. Collaborated via Jira and Confluence for sprint planning and runbooks.

Go Developer, Zentrix Labs
Oct 2024 - Nov 2024
Implemented Go-based backend for a telemetry aggregation product, designing Microservices that exposed gRPC endpoints for high-throughput ingestion. Containerized services with Docker and deployed to Kubernetes clusters for staging and load tests. Wrote integration tests and documented APIs in Confluence; tracked tasks and releases in Jira.

Backend Engineer, Finlytics
May 2016 - Sep 2024
Built and maintained Microservices for analytics pipelines and real-time scoring in a PostgreSQL-backed platform. Optimized query patterns and connection pooling to improve latency for key endpoints by 40%. Packaged services with Docker and operated on Linux-based hosts; coordinated deployments to Kubernetes for scalable batch processing. Used gRPC for low-latency communication between scoring and ingestion services and authored runbooks in Confluence while managing work through Jira.

Backend Engineer, PhonePe

Developed Microservices for transaction processing and reconciliation using PostgreSQL for durable storage. Implemented gRPC interfaces for synchronous flows and helped migrate components into Kubernetes clusters to improve fault isolation. Tuned Linux-based servers and container workloads to meet peak traffic demands; documented system designs and tracked delivery in Jira and Confluence.
